name: Druid of the Claw
label: Quest
description: Deep within the barrows of Teldrassil, the spectral form of Oben Rageclaw asks for a tragic release. Corrupted furbolgs have placed a dark enchantment…
intro: Deep within the barrows of Teldrassil, the spectral form of Oben Rageclaw asks for a tragic release. Corrupted furbolgs have placed a dark enchantment over his physical vessel, forcing you to destroy his soulless shell and break the bond so his spirit may return to the Emerald Dream.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: After examining this charm, friend, I see now what must be done. Please take it, and do as I ask.

You are to explore the deepest areas of the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. There, you will find my soulless body... Although I regret what I am about to tell you, I see no other way to free myself from the control of the Gnarlpine.
In order for me to escape them, you must kill my physical form. Once that is done, use the voodoo charm on my fallen body. After you have completed this task, please return to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, be wary when approaching my physical form; the enchantment it is under is quite powerful.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I am finally free of the control of the Gnarlpine. Thank you, friend.
My spirit may now rest peacefully forever in the Emerald Dream.
Perhaps one day we may meet again, young adventurer. But, for now, please accept this reward as a symbol of my gratitude.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
